story_note: Phil begins another morning with the gentle ritual of tea and puzzle, noticing at once the subtle shift in clue style demanding fresh focus.
continuation_note: Having unlocked a key column, Phil's momentum builds steadily, and he plans a return visit tomorrow for the puzzle's satisfying conclusion.

scenes.title: Back Again
scenes.beat: Return after yesterday, new daily puzzle, same habit
scenes.caption: Phil pours tea as he opens the new puzzle.

scenes.title: Different Start
scenes.beat: The first move shows today's puzzle is different
scenes.dialogue: This first clue takes a new turn.
scenes.caption: A fresh twist sets the tone early.

scenes.title: The Pushback
scenes.beat: A fair stuck moment, no guessing
scenes.dialogue: I need to pause—guessing won't help.
scenes.caption: Phil reflects carefully on tricky clues.

scenes.title: The Follow-Through
scenes.dialogue: The rest is beginning to flow.
scenes.caption: Answers slot steadily into the grid.

scenes.title: Worth Returning For
scenes.beat: Completion or honest latest progress, return tomorrow
scenes.caption: Progress made; a return visit awaits.

style_rules: No masthead inside individual scene art.
Sapiver Press logo/title only on merchandise and monitor/browser URL.

The scene should be comic illustration, not photorealism.
